description:
Enable the Fixed Assets module in Manager.io and record the purchase of a new asset. 

1. Go to Settings > Customize and enable the 'Fixed Assets' module.
2. Navigate to the Fixed Assets tab and create a new item named 'MacBook Pro'.
3. Navigate to Suppliers and create a new supplier named 'TechWorld'.
4. Create a new Purchase Invoice from 'TechWorld' dated today. 
5. In the invoice, select the 'Fixed assets' account (or 'Fixed assets - at cost'), then select the 'MacBook Pro' item. 
6. Set the Unit Price to 2500.00 and save the invoice.
